command:
docker run --rm \
  -v /Users/manyashetty/Desktop/ds000114:/data:ro \
  -v /Users/manyashetty/Desktop/Agentic_fMRIPrep/output/session_flag_test:/out \
  -v /Users/manyashetty/Desktop/Agentic_fMRIPrep/license.txt:/opt/freesurfer/license.txt:ro \
  nipreps/fmriprep:latest \
  /data /out participant \
  --participant-label 01 \
  --session-label retest \
  --skip-bids-validation \
  --anat-only \
  --sloppy \
  --low-mem \
  --mem_mb 4000 \
  --nprocs 1 \
  --output-spaces MNI152NLin2009cAsym \
  --use-syn-sdc \
  --fs-no-reconall \
  -w /out/work

fallback_flags.reason: No fieldmap directory found for participant; enabling fieldmap-less SyN SDC.
